info.name: MediTrack - Backend API Collection
info.description: Comprehensive and exhaustive Postman collection for the MediTrack / Medication Adherence System Backend API (Node.js, Express, Prisma, PostgreSQL). Includes all authentication, medication management, dose tracking, adherence scoring, caregiver/doctor relationships, notifications, reports, and real-time chat endpoints.

variable.description: JWT Access Token for Bearer Authorization

request.description: Check if the server is running and get general service health status.

item.name: API v1 Health Check (With DB Check)

request.description: Detailed system and PostgreSQL database connectivity check (returns uptime and service status).
Register a new user account. Valid roles: `PATIENT`, `CAREGIVER`, `DOCTOR`, `ADMIN`. Generates verification token and default streak.
Verify user's email address using the token received in email. Returns HTML success confirmation page with redirection to login.
Authenticate user with email and password. Returns `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, and user info.
Rotate and exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token and new refresh token.
Logout user and invalidate their stored refresh token.
Initiate password reset. Sends a reset link containing a reset token to the user's email.
Renders the web HTML form for user to enter a new password.
Resets the user's password using the token and invalidates all existing refresh sessions.
Fetch logged-in user profile, role, verification status, and timestamps.
Retrieves complete user profile along with current adherence streak information.
Updates user's personal details, medical info, and timezone.
Change password for the logged-in user with current password validation.
Registers device token for Web Push, Android (FCM), or iOS (APNS).
Deactivates the current user's account (`isActive: false`).

query.description: Filter by role: PATIENT, CAREGIVER, DOCTOR, ADMIN

request.description: Administrator endpoint to list and paginate all registered users.

request.description: Returns all medications belonging to the authenticated patient.
Returns all dose schedules for today along with medication details, status, and local timezone.
Returns the weekly calendar of scheduled medication doses for the 7-day period.
Returns details of a specific medication including the 10 most recent dose schedules.
Update medication details. Automatically recalculates upcoming pending dose schedules if timing or frequency changed.
Deactivates a medication (`isActive: false`). Does not permanently delete historic logs.
Check in and record a dose. The system calculates whether the dose is TAKEN on time or LATE, updates adherence stats, and increases streak.
Mark a scheduled dose as SKIPPED with an optional reason note.

query.description: Filter status: TAKEN, LATE, SKIPPED, MISSED

request.description: Fetch paginated history of all taken, late, and skipped doses.
Fetch all past dose schedules whose window has closed without being taken.
Fetch all doses scheduled for today for quick action.
Returns full comprehensive adherence breakdown across medications and dose history over the past year.

query.description: Number of days to calculate adherence score for (e.g., 7, 30, 90)

request.description: Returns overall adherence percentage score and scheduled/taken/missed/late/skipped count breakdown.
Returns breakdown of scheduled, taken, late, missed, and skipped doses for a single specific day.
Returns the current day streak and longest streak achieved.
Returns adherence score and daily breakdown for an arbitrary custom date range.
Caregiver or Doctor sends a link connection request to a patient by email.
Patient approves or rejects a caregiver link request. Automatically creates a conversation thread upon acceptance.
Retrieves incoming caregiver/doctor link requests waiting for patient approval.
Returns list of all linked patients, including their profiles and 30-day adherence scores.
Detailed view of patient profile, active medications, recent dose logs, streak, and unread alerts.
Removes caregiver/doctor link to a patient.
Fetches alerts generated for missed patient doses, low adherence, or system warnings.
Updates caregiver alert status to READ.
Returns list of in-app reminders and notifications with unread count.
Quick endpoint to poll or query the number of unread notifications for notification badges.
Fallback mechanism to dispatch dose reminders for upcoming window (used if background cron is delayed).
Mark specific notification IDs as read, or pass empty array/body to mark all notifications as read.
Permanently delete an individual notification.
Returns complete adherence statistics, medication breakdowns, and daily logs for the past 30 days.
Returns or generates the weekly adherence summary report, including best and worst adherence days.
Returns paginated list of all archived weekly adherence reports.
Generates current weekly report and sends it formatted to user's registered email address.
Allows linked caregiver or doctor to inspect a specific patient's weekly adherence report.
Returns all active chat conversations for the user with latest message preview.
Fetches message history for a given conversation thread.
Sends a new message in a conversation thread between patient and caregiver/doctor.
